name: scroll_compressor_semi_empirical
title: Semi-empirical hermetic scroll compressor in a refrigeration cycle
summary: Reference model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002) as implemented by V. Lemort: six-step compression path (supply drop, heating-up, isentropic compression to the adapted pressure, isochoric compression, exhaust cooling, exhaust drop) with internal leakage, fictitious-wall heat transfers and electromechanical losses; parameters identified on a Copeland ZR72KC-TFD catalogue, refrigerant cycle reduced to an evaporator and a condenser at imposed saturation temperatures. A simplified variant without leakage (converted from the EES original in bar/kJ units) and a test-campaign variant (28 measured R22 points of the identification file, model vs measurements) are included.

authors: Vincent Lemort (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory); model of Winandy, Saavedra & Lebrun (2002)

verification.summary: Main model vs EES stored solution (120 common variables): key outputs within 0.1 %, worst 1.5 %. Simplified variant vs stored solution of scroll_compressor.EES: within 0.1 %. Test-campaign variant (TM-0278) vs its stored solution (row 28): M_dot, W_dot within 0.05 %, t_ex 0.4 K; vs 28 measurements: mean abs. error 1.4 % (flow), 1.0 % (power).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last run: t_ev = 7 °C, t_cd = 45 °C, R22); simplified variant against the EES stored solution of CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip:scroll_compressor.EES (t_ev = 30 °C, t_cd = 40 °C), converted to SI; test-campaign variant against the stored solution of 3_3_1_Identification.EES (row 28) and the 28 test points of its table
verification.notes: Main model: all key outputs (M_dot_r, W_dot_cp, Q_dot_ev, Q_dot_cd, t_ex_cp, t_w_cp, efficiencies) within 0.1%; largest deviation 1.5% on the small derived quantity w_in2_cp (EES 7.9 vs CoolProp R22 properties). Variant: key outputs within 0.1% after hand conversion bar/kJ -> Pa/J; deviations only on intentionally converted cells (C_sd_cp, DELTAp_su1_cp). Test-campaign variant: stored solution (row 28) within 0.1% for 52 of 76 common variables, others within 1.3% except DELTAp_su1_cp (corrected), ERRtex_cp, Q_dot_amb_mes_cp; model vs the 28 measurements: flow mean abs 1.41% (max 3.20%), power 0.95% (max 2.87%), t_ex 1.56 K (max 5.41 K). The measurements are the data the parameters were fitted on.
